## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
CAUTION. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive (Energy, Utilities); confirmed by very weak sector breadth and narrow, energy-heavy leadership while mega-cap Tech is broadly BELOW TREND — conflicting signals warrant caution.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +3.96% | 1M: +7.80%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.56% | 1M: +10.00%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +5.66% | 1M: +14.55%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities show pockets of strength: DOW (1W: +9.66% | 1M: +21.38%) ABOVE TREND and CEG (1W: +5.50% | 1M: +4.83%) ABOVE TREND. Materials strong via DOW (see above).  

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Technology weak: AAPL (1W: -4.17% | 1M: -5.28%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -3.23% | 1M: -1.05%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -3.03% | 1M: -2.47%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare lagging: AMGN (1W: -6.93% | 1M: -5.86%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -8.18% | 1M: -11.39%) BELOW TREND, ABBV (1W: -8.49% | 1M: -10.53%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary weak: SBUX (1W: -8.66% | 1M: -2.86%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -3.69% | 1M: -4.35%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: DOW (1W: +9.66% | 1M: +21.38%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +6.89% | 1M: -2.05%) RECOVERY, COP (1W: +5.66% | 1M: +14.55%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +5.50% | 1M: +4.83%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +5.04% | 1M: +27.68%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (Energy/Utilities/Materials, Energy-heavy).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: AMGN (1W: -6.93% | 1M: -5.86%) BELOW TREND, EMR (1W: -6.94% | 1M: -12.74%) BELOW TREND, GE (1W: -7.44% | 1M: -7.85%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -7.51% | 1M: -4.99%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -8.18% | 1M: -11.39%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated across Tech, Industrials and Healthcare.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W movers: DOW (1W: +9.66% | 1M: +21.38%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +6.89% | 1M: -2.05%) RECOVERY, COP (1W: +5.66% | 1M: +14.55%) ABOVE TREND — watch EMR (1W: -6.94% | 1M: -12.74%) BELOW TREND which has bullish news but is trading down (news/price divergence).

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Technology is weak and internally under pressure with broad mega-cap declines: AAPL (1W: -4.17% | 1M: -5.28%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -3.23% | 1M: -1.05%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -3.03% | 1M: -2.47%) BELOW TREND; sector 1W performance -2.51% signals continuation risk and sentiment/buyback headlines are not lifting prices.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials are soft: JPM (1W: +0.08% | 1M: -6.31%) RECOVERY while V (1W: -3.22% | 1M: -6.41%) BELOW TREND and MA (1W: -3.08% | 1M: -6.41%) BELOW TREND — overall Financials showing weakness (sector 1W -1.66%), so no clear bid from banks.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare is under pressure overall (1W -3.10%) with clear dispersion: JNJ (1W: -2.35% | 1M: -1.97%) BELOW TREND despite positive FDA headlines, PFE (1W: +0.07% | 1M: -0.18%) RECOVERY, while LLY (1W: -8.18% | 1M: -11.39%) BELOW TREND shows headline-driven volatility and legal/news mixed signals.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor Energy and select Utilities exposure given ABOVE TREND leadership (XOM, CVX, COP); reduce exposure to broad Tech and select Consumer Discretionary names showing clear BELOW TREND trends (AAPL, MSFT, SBUX). Style: Value/Cyclical tilt within a cautionary framework—monitor mega-cap divergences before adding to core positions.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: XOM (1W: +3.96% | 1M: +7.80%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.56% | 1M: +10.00%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +9.66% | 1M: +21.38%) ABOVE TREND for momentum continuation. BEARISH: ADBE (1W: -10.12% | 1M: -5.55%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -7.51% | 1M: -4.99%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -8.18% | 1M: -11.39%) BELOW TREND for vulnerability.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +2.39% | 1M: +11.70%; Breadth: positive) and Utilities (1W: +1.50% | 1M: +1.15%). BEARISH: Technology (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -0.67%) and Healthcare (1W: -3.10% | 1M: -5.68%) for continued selling pressure.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch NVDA (1W: -3.03% | 1M: -2.47%) BELOW TREND for failure to reclaim short-term support as a trigger for wider risk-off in Tech; monitor AAPL (1W: -4.17% | 1M: -5.28%) BELOW TREND for a sustained breakdown vs 1M trend; XOM (1W: +3.96% | 1M: +7.80%) ABOVE TREND sustaining 1M strength would confirm Energy-led carry.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
NVDA (1W: -3.03% | 1M: -2.47%) (+60): CEO bullish comments; price BELOW TREND — sentiment not yet reflected in price (divergence). EMR (1W: -6.94% | 1M: -12.74%) (+60): upgraded guidance/buyback but trading down BELOW TREND — distribution signal. JNJ (1W: -2.35% | 1M: -1.97%) (+75): regulatory win; price BELOW TREND — watch for follow-through. PFE (1W: +0.07% | 1M: -0.18%) (+55): trial success; price RECOVERY — sentiment more aligned with price.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
SBUX (1W: -8.66% | 1M: -2.86%) (-55): downgrade; price BELOW TREND confirming downside. LLY (1W: -8.18% | 1M: -11.39%) (-50/+55 mixed): legal/flow concerns and mixed pipeline headlines; price BELOW TREND and volatile. ADBE (1W: -10.12% | 1M: -5.55%) (-45): analyst cut and price sharply BELOW TREND; clear downside pressure. TSLA (1W: -3.69% | 1M: -4.35%) (-45): competitive/tech disruption headlines and price BELOW TREND.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with a Value/Cyclical tilt given Energy and Utilities leadership amid very weak breadth (Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive). XOM (1W: +3.96% | 1M: +7.80%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.56% | 1M: +10.00%) ABOVE TREND and DOW (1W: +9.66% | 1M: +21.38%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: broad Tech and large-cap Healthcare are BELOW TREND and several bullish headlines (NVDA, EMR, JNJ) are not translating to price, so monitor for further divergence before adding exposure.
